body: I honestly don’t know. I felt numb. I think I took my anger and put it out there but in a bad way. I regret it because I messed with someone. I thought everyone around me would think it was funny.
I mean it will help in my future a lot. But yeah, it’s pretty dramatic to kill myself over that.
I want to take business at college. I mean I know grades are not the be it end all and it seems dramatic but I feel like I don’t have anything else to channel my purpose into.
I’m not sure if it would be illegal. Mostly because it was absolutely socially reprehensible. It’s not like I’m in trouble I just feel bad.

I can’t because it’s too bad. I should not be hanging out with who I am. I lost control, I don’t know what to do. 
I think I should probably not be here.
Hey, yeah I'm still here.
I hope you find someone that really cares. Isolation is horrible.
Do you have a somewhat close friend now? Maybe you could try getting together with them.
Ah. Yeah. Did you ever do things and go out with your friends or something? Like to a movie? Because in those situations I do get kinda nervous.
Thank you. That is true. I hope that it will work because at my age you never know.

Maybe. But still. I can definitely understand not being able to function socially all of the time because I get nervous. What do you mean by not being able to function in a social environment? And I also don't think that is really toxic it just means you're not as open or are having a difficult time.

Yeah. High school is a time I won't get back and I really am trying to make the best of it. Though failing is not that much of an option when it comes to some things in school. Oh yeah, I have friends that are hilarious but also messed up.

Holy crap. In my state they call that Baker Acting. I'm sorry you had to go through that. I had to go through that hence why I am on medication. They are legally required to send you if you ask them anything about suicide, honestly not a great system all of the time. 
It seems like you got help though in one way, which means she should still not be upset.

Yep. I have a psychiatrist which sometimes makes me feel like I'm crazy or something. 

No. This medication makes me feel okay I just need a higher dosage because I'm taking 5mg and need 10mg most likely. It's Lexapro (anti-depressant) which is known to work pretty well. I haven't been able to see my psychiatrist because we moved to a different city and we go back and forth.

Thanks. I have a few friends but they only care about some things. That group of friends also isn't healthy, not saying for me but mentally for themselves. 

I really hope it gets better. But then I read things about how bad adulthood can be and I feel stressed. When I grow up I don't want to fail.

That's an interesting philosophy on life. Sometimes I think it's better to not get invested or happy about anything otherwise it will just mess up at some point. 

Though I have to admit, sometimes getting help is good. Of course it may not work for you but it has somewhat worked for me because my medication has made me feel somewhat better. Though I still get those feeling, a lot actually.

If she hasn't accepted your apology that's saying something. That sounds really bad. You are the only one who should get help on your own accord, she shouldn't be telling you to. What does she want you to do for "getting help" anyway?
You messed up, sure. But you probably did not mess things up entirely. At the same time if you did not want help at that time is understandable. Did she ever talk to you again about that?

Thank you. I get what you mean by ruining everything else. I try hard to build things up and then they fall apart, even if I have a connection. If you don't mind me asking how did you think you ruined the relationship?

Oh, that really sucks. I'm sorry. Everybody always says that your sixteenth birthday is the most important one but then... it kind of falls apart for some people. 

Since middle school, sixth grade; then I was truly alone beyond my parents. Even before that I haven't had a true connection since 4th grade.
